Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting neck and back pain beginning immediately after
the event. Over three visits, the patient was evaluated and managed for cervical and lumbar strain. The reported injury pattern is
consistent with the mechanism of a lateral impact of this kind. Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and
restricted range of motion in the neck and lower back, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft-tissue injury. No prior injury
to the same body regions is known from the patient's history. Treatment followed a typical course of conservative care, including
manual therapy, stretching exercises, and short-term anti-inflammatory medication. Symptoms and function improved steadily
across visits, and care was tapered accordingly. Two similar claims submitted on the same day are currently under routine review,
and this summary does not alter that process.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
